source.title: Parameterized complexity of machine scheduling: 15 open problems

accepted.question_text: Consider the single-machine scheduling problem 1||Σw_jT_j, where each job j has a processing time p_j, a due date d_j, and a weight w_j, and the objective is to minimize total weighted tardiness. Is this problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the maximum processing time p_max = max_j p_j?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 1. Is 1||ΣwjT j fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax?

accepted.question_text: Consider the single-machine precedence-constrained scheduling problem 1|prec|Σw_jC_j, where jobs have precedence constraints and the objective is to minimize the total weighted completion time. Does this problem admit a problem kernel whose size is polynomial in the gap between the optimum objective value and the lower bound given by the natural linear-programming relaxation?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 2. Does 1|prec|ΣwjCj admit a problem kernel of size polynomial in the difference between the optimum and the lower bound obtained from its natural LP relaxation?

accepted.question_text: For the single-machine throughput problems 1|r_j|ΣU_j and 1|r_j|Σw_jU_j, where each job j has a release date r_j and U_j indicates whether the job misses its due date, are these problems W[1]-hard when parameterized by the maximum processing time p_max?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 3. Are 1|rj|ΣUj and 1|rj|ΣwjUj W[1]-hard parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax?

accepted.question_text: In single-machine makespan minimization with forbidden start times and forbidden completion times, where τ is the number of forbidden times, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by τ?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 4. Is makespan minimization on a single machine with τ forbidden start and end times fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by τ?

accepted.question_text: Consider makespan minimization on parallel identical machines, P||C_max, in the high-multiplicity encoding, where there are p distinct processing times and both the processing times and the number of jobs of each type are encoded in binary. Is this problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by p, the number of distinct processing times?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5. Is P||Cmax with high-multiplicity encoding fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number p of distinct processing times, that is, when job processing times pj and the number of jobs for each processing time are encoded in binary?

accepted.question_text: For the three-machine precedence-constrained unit-processing-time makespan problem P3|prec, p_j=1|C_max, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the width of the partial order induced by the precedence constraints?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 6. Is P3|prec, pj=1|Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the width of the partial order induced by the precedence constraints?

accepted.question_text: For parallel identical machines with release dates and equal processing times, namely P|r_j, p_j=p|Σw_jU_j and P|r_j, p_j=p|ΣU_j, are these problems fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the number of machines?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 7. Are P|rj, pj=p|ΣwjUj and P|rj, pj=p|ΣUj fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number of machines?

accepted.question_text: Consider the interval-scheduling or just-in-time problem P|M_j, d_j-r_j=p_j|Σw_jU_j on parallel identical machines, where each job j may run only on a specified subset M_j of machines and its processing window is exactly [r_j, d_j]. Is this problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the number of machines?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 8. Is P|Mj, dj−rj=pj|ΣwjUj fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number of machines?

accepted.question_text: In preemptive scheduling on parallel identical machines, are the three problems P|pmtn,r_j|ΣC_j, P|pmtn|ΣU_j, and P|pmtn|ΣT_j fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by p, the number of distinct processing times appearing among the jobs?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9. Are the above problems fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number p of distinct processing times?
The three problems P|pmtn,rj|ΣCj, P|pmtn|ΣUj, and P|pmtn|ΣT j are all NP-hard

accepted.question_text: For the two-machine preemptive weighted tardiness problem P2|pmtn, p_j=p|Σw_jT_j, in which all jobs have the same processing time p, is the problem W[1]-hard when parameterized by that common processing time p?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 10. Is P2|pmtn, pj=p|ΣwjT j W[1]-hard parameterized by the processing time p of all jobs?

accepted.question_text: For the three-machine flow-shop makespan problem F3||C_max, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the maximum processing time p_max of an operation?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 11. Is F3||Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax?

accepted.question_text: For the three-machine job-shop makespan problem J3||C_max, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized jointly by the maximum processing time p_max and by n_max, the maximum number of operations belonging to any one job?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 12. Is J3||Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax and the maximum number nmax of operations per job?

accepted.question_text: For job-shop makespan minimization J||C_max, does there exist an algorithm that, for every ε > 0, computes a (1+ε)-approximation in time f(m, ε)·poly(n), where m is the number of machines and n is the input size?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 13. Is there an algorithm that yields a (1 + ε)-approximation for J||Cmax in f(m, ε) · poly(n) time?

accepted.question_text: Consider the open-shop makespan problem O|p_ij=1, STsd,b|C_max with unit operation times and sequence-dependent setup times between g job batches. Is this problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by g, the number of batches?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 14. Is O|pi j = 1, STsd,b|Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number g of batches?

accepted.question_text: For the open-shop throughput problem O|p_ij=1, r_j|Σw_jU_j, where every operation has unit processing time and jobs have release dates, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the number of machines?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 15. Is O|pi j=1,rj|ΣwjUj fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number of machines?
